card.name: Inside long words, mid-spelling
card.fires_on: Partway through long medical or technical words (extracorporeal, desethylamiodarone, lopinavir, inhalation) and occasionally on 'days' after a number. The marked piece is followed by the rest of the word.

modes.label: Inside long drug or medical terms
modes.description: A middle piece of a multi-part medical word, where the rest of the word follows.

modes.label: Days after a number
modes.description: The word 'days' right after a number in treatment duration or symptom timing.
modes.example: If you still feel sick after 7<< days>>, see your health care provider
